briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch escalates AGI race as compute and safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid intensifying US-China competition. Funding surges in infrastructure while safety concerns mount over unpatched vulnerabilities in deployed systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with multimodal reasoning breakthroughs. Anthropic and Google DeepMind countered with Claude 4 and Gemini 2.5 updates. xAI Grok-3 and DeepSeek R2 push open-source performance boundaries.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and Google announced new 100k H100 clusters in Texas and Nevada. TSMC ramped 3nm AI chip production for custom accelerators.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will protocol-level defenses like dynamic dialects become mandatory for all frontier model deployments by 2027?
